fix: I think you would find no one better suited than me to stand beside you and help you.
reason: ἄλλον … ἡμῶν ἐπιτηδειότερον: ἡμῶν is genitive of comparison; Polybius offers himself.

fix: This tendency blazed out, as it were, at the time we are speaking of,
reason: παροῦσαν αἵρεσιν is the extravagance just described, not Scipio's ambition; πρῶτον μὲν introduces the first cause, not first appearance.

fix: Scipio gave to his mother [...], who had long since been separated from Lucius
reason: Lacuna (***) after τῇ μητρί must be marked; name (Papiria) not supplied in text.

fix: But when he insisted that Scipio had given exactly those instructions, they did not believe him and went on to the young man
reason: διαπιστήσαντες = disbelieving; English inverted the sense.

fix: After this, he was obliged to pay the remaining half of the dowries owed to the daughters of Scipio the Great, who were the sisters of his adoptive father [...].
reason: Lacuna (*** λαβόντος) lost a genitive participle clause; mark it, do not supply.
